name: Grandine
source:
Grandine is the artificial version of [url=https://vndb.org/c5279]Undine[/url], created and mass produced by [url=https://vndb.org/c17591]Promestein[/url].

Using the flow, Grandine makes her wielder's attacks hit multiple times. However, Grandine does not seem to improve her wielder's avoidance rate, or at least the wielder never actually tries to avoid [url=https://vndb.org/c4311]Luka[/url]'s attacks.

[From [url=https://mgq.miraheze.org/wiki/Grandine]Mon-musu Quest Wiki[/url]]
